design_notes: Overnight nonstops of 775 and 780 minutes (single leg nine hours or more) leave London in the afternoon and land on March 3rd before noon; the negotiation with the external partner starts at 5 pm that day, the day of landing and the day after leaving, so 'the same or following day' holds counted from either end (lines 124-132). The Executive Director approved business class beforehand (lines 133-134) and the Head of Financial Control approved the air cost above the Annex 2 ceiling (lines 108-111). Of the two business options the most economical (lines 137-139): BA at EUR 4,100, not above EUR 5,000.
